evidence.verbatim_excerpt: is anticipated to include 60 one, two, three, and four bedroom apartment units affordable across a range of incomes, including 12 market rate units and 48 units that will be affordable to families with incomes between 30% - 60% of Area Median Income.
evidence.neutral_statement: The 2024 Project Plan states the residential component is anticipated to include 60 apartment units, of which 12 are market rate and 48 are affordable to households between 30% and 60% of Area Median Income.
limitations: The plan says 'anticipated'; it is a planned program, not a completed outcome.

evidence.neutral_statement: The 2024 Project Plan, Table A, sets TOTAL Capital Project Costs at an up-to amount of $700,000, consisting of a grant to the Developer/Residential Owner.
limitations: 'Up-to' amount: a ceiling, not a spent figure.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: Total Estimated Project Costs, excluding financing $ 763,750
evidence.neutral_statement: The 2024 Project Plan estimates Total Project Costs, excluding financing, at $763,750 (the $700,000 grant plus $63,750 administration).
The 2024 Annual TID Report (TID 121 Periodic Report as of 12/31/24) lists authorized expenditure of $763,750 under authorizing resolution #240382.
The 'Completion Status' field on the TID 121 Periodic Report is blank. The record does not state a completion status.
limitations: A blank field is recorded as unknown, not as 'not started' or 'complete'.

evidence.neutral_statement: The Expenditures Life-to-Date table (as of 12/31/2024) shows a Grant to Developer budget of $700,000 with no appropriations, encumbrances, or expenditures recorded.
limitations: The 'within budget' and 'on schedule' check-box answers cannot be read from the extracted text and are treated as UNKNOWN.

evidence.neutral_statement: Amendment No. 1 (2026) states the City shall fund an estimated $2,345,000 in TID Capital Project Costs.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: Amendment 1 Grant to Project (Monetary Obligation to Developer/Commercial Owner) $1,645,000* TOTAL Capital Project Costs $2,345,000
evidence.neutral_statement: Amendment No. 1, Table A, adds an up-to $1,645,000 grant to the Developer/Commercial Owner, bringing TOTAL Capital Project Costs to $2,345,000.
limitations: 'Up-to' amounts: ceilings, not spent figures. The record does not state why the amendment was needed.
